claims.claim: The pick policy has modes ordered, random and jev, and only the builder role can set it
Only the builder role can set a pick policy
Random gives each eligible lineup member the same chance
Jev falls back to the first eligible member without a confident (>= 0.7) valid choice
A design preference selects the configured family when eligible and design is requested
Cached usage skips a family that is exhausted or below the reserve; unknown evidence leaves it eligible
When no family is eligible the picker returns an error
An exclusion must name a known family
